privacy.title: How your data is handled
privacy.onDevice: Your progress, settings and streak are stored only on this phone. There is no account and no server.
privacy.ads: The app is supported by ads from Google AdMob. AdMob may use your phone's advertising ID. Where the law requires it, you are asked for your choice first, and you can change it later under Settings, Privacy choices.
privacy.notifications: The daily reminder is a notification made on your phone. It is off until you turn it on, and nothing about it is sent anywhere.
privacy.noAccount: The app does not ask for your name, email, location, contacts or photos.
privacy.choices: You can erase your progress at any time in Settings, Reset progress, or by uninstalling the app.
